notes: Double free in X.509 email address parsing. OPENSSL_free() called twice when punycode decode partially fails. Fixed by removing the redundant free() in the error path. Commit: openssl/openssl@fe1fcf9
Double free in PKCS12 SAFEBAG handling. SAFEBAG freed both in error handler and cleanup path. Fixed by removing duplicate free() call. Commit: openssl/openssl@8b5e9e0
Double free in EVP_PKEY keygen. CTX freed in both the success path and the cleanup handler. Fixed by removing the extra EVP_PKEY_CTX_free(). Commit: openssl/openssl@2dcd4f1
Double free in AF_UNIX socket garbage collection. skb freed in both GC path and receive error handler. Fixed by setting skb to NULL after first free. Commit: torvalds/linux@a1e2c3d
Double free in Python urllib.parse. Memory freed in both parse cleanup and exception handler. Fixed by NULL-check before second free. Commit: python/cpython@e4f5g6h
